- `psubband1_t` gets 4 writes (2+2), starting at index 63 going down

- `psubband1_t2` gets 4 writes (2+2), starting at index 127 going down

- `psubband_t` wrote indices 0-27
- `psubband1_t` wrote indices 63-36
- `psubband_t2` wrote indices 64-91
- `psubband1_t2` wrote indices 127-100

And `ixheaacd_radix4bfly(p_twiddle, &subband_tmp[64], 1, 8)` reads `subband_tmp[64..95]`, which includes uninitialized indices 92-95.
